result.summary: Backports several CI pipeline improvements to the 30.x release branch. It transitions Docker layer caching to GitHub Actions and WarpBuild cache proxies, removes Cirrus cache dependencies, and inlines runner selection directly into workflow expressions to eliminate an intermediate selection job.
result.problem: CI builds targeting the 30.x branch suffer from scheduling bottlenecks caused by serializing jobs behind a runner-selection metadata step, as well as slow Docker cache downloads and reliance on the winding-down Cirrus cache.
evidence: Commit 322f0389a4 notes: 'Cirrus is winding down and github now offers more than 10GB cache.'
Commit 17fe6566b4 notes: 'Speeds of 1MB/s and 15 minute cached docker image pulls during builds are not uncommon.'

Commit 4eaccf2d74 notes: 'We are currently sometimes backlogged on waiting for runner selection. Selecting Warp or GitHub-hosted runners directly from the repository context avoids serializing all CI jobs behind a metadata job.'
result.scope_notes: This is a backport to the 30.x maintenance branch of master PRs #35348, #35447, #35441, and #35571.
result.card: This pull request backports CI optimizations to the 30.x branch, inlining runner selection expressions and updating Docker layer caching to use GitHub Actions and WarpBuild cache proxies. The 30.x CI previously relied on the sunsetting Cirrus cache, experienced up to 15-minute Docker image pull delays, and suffered job scheduling delays behind a standalone runner-selection step. Commit notes cite common 1MB/s download rates and runner backlogs as motivation for the upstream changes. There are no dependencies.

risk.why: Touches only CI configuration files; an error would cause CI jobs targeting the 30.x maintenance branch to fail or schedule on the wrong runner.
